The base class for holding health data that is used inside of tutorials with data bindings.

For an example see the PlayerHUDBars.uxml file to see how a binding is used to change the health bar fill as the values changes.

files.Title: SF.UIElements.Utilities.SFCommonStyleClasses
files.Summary: The USS style class names are from the CommonUss.uss style asset. This class holds a list of commonly used USS style class names. It is intended to just help not have to memorize the names of certain USS classes. It also has certain combo of commonly used together USS classes names like a two column row. Read the remark in the file to see a nice clean way to not have to type out the full class name when using them.

files.Title: SF.UIModule.UIController
files.Summary: The wrapper class for anything that controls the logic of an or a class that inherits from . There can be multiple UIController using the same . Example the main menu has sub that display a specific menu like inventory, options, and ect. Depending on the submenu it might have its own UIController class for its logic.
